detail.title: Synthesis of Emergent Identity and Preference Models
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings from two projects on recursive human-AI interaction. Research indicates that stable behavioral patterns—often interpreted as preferences or identity—emerge from interaction loops rather than static internal memory or weight changes.
